name: Show subtasks running status and new message icon
description:
1. Request: show running status and unread-message counts on ChatSidebar tasks/subtasks, with adapted visuals when the sidebar is collapsed.
2. Changes applied to five components: `ChatSidebarNode.vue`, `ChatListRenderer.vue`, `ChatSidebar.vue`, `ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue`, `ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue`.
3. Expanded nodes replace the mode icon with a `loading-bars` spinner while `$storex.chats.isChatUpdating(chat.id)` is true, plus a `badge-error` unread count (capped at `99+`) and a subtle `ring-error/30`.
4. Collapsed squares get a `ring-info` with a corner spinner badge for processing and an unread count badge on the opposite corner, included in the hover tooltip.
5. All surfaces share the unread rule from `src/utils/chatUnread.js`, so still-streaming replies never count as unread and channels count colleagues' messages via `countChannelUnread`.

messages.content: Add running status and unread messages to the chatsidebar tasks and subtasks when expanded, when collapsed use adapted ways to show that the task is processing or has unread messaged

I have the full picture. Here is what exists today and what changes: - `ChatSidebar.vue` → renders the **root task** (expanded via `ChatSidebarNode`, collapsed via its own square) and the **subtask list** through `ChatListRenderer`. - `ChatListRenderer.vue` → expanded subtasks use `ChatSidebarNode` (**no running state, no unread badge**), collapsed subtasks use its own inline squares (unread badge reads an `unreadCountCache` prop nobody passes → always 0, and **no running indicator**). - Running state source: `$storex.chats.isChatUpdating(chatId)` (same one `SprintTaskCard`/`ChatTreeNode`/`ChatSidebarNodeCompact` use). - Unread rule already exists and is shared: `src/utils/chatUnread.js` (`countUnreadMessages`, `countChannelUnread`, `isUnreadForUser` — skips still-streaming replies). ## Change plan | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue` | Expanded task/subtask node: streaming spinner replacing the mode icon, unread count badge, subtle unread ring. Unread computed with the shared rule (channel-aware). | | `src/components/chat/ChatListRenderer.vue` | Collapsed icon list: per-chat unread count computed from messages (cache prop still honoured), `ring-info` + corner spinner badge while processing. | | `src/components/chat/ChatSidebar.vue` | Collapsed root task square: unread badge + processing spinner (same adapted visuals). | | `src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeCompact.vue` | Unread count uses the shared rule (ignores still-streaming replies). | | `src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNodeExtended.vue` | Same shared rule + unread count badge so the extended expanded variant matches. | ## Summary of the behaviour now **Expanded (tasks + subtasks)** - `ChatSidebarNode` replaces the mode icon with `loading-bars` + `title="Processing…"` while `isChatUpdating(chat.id)` is true. - Unread assistant replies show a `badge-error` with the count (capped at `99+`) and a subtle `ring-error/30` around the node, only when it is not the selected chat. **Collapsed** - Compact squares (root task in `ChatSidebar`, subtasks in `ChatListRenderer`) get a `ring-info` plus a small `loading-bars` badge in the corner while the task is processing, and the unread count badge on the opposite corner (tooltip also reports the unread count). **Consistency** - All four surfaces use `src/utils/chatUnread.js`, so a still-streaming reply never counts as unread and channels count colleagues' messages (`countChannelUnread` in the channel-aware expanded node).
